# git-history-extracts

Selected git-history extracts from prior repos. For archaeology.

## Stack & contents

13 flat markdown files, one per source repo (e.g. `agent-vm-ema.md`, `host-ema.md`, `host-mission-control-claude.md`, `host-place-org-openclaw.md`, `host-superman.md`).

## Why this is here

Records branch/commit/filter history. Use when you need to know **what existed when** without cloning the original repos.

## How to load it efficiently

```bash
git show origin/git-history-extracts:host-ema.md | head -60
```
